dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, have you guys reached a conclusion?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose we've reached a common understanding after ample discussion.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: And that is to... make a "film" that includes both elements.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: The story I have in my head is that of a samurai slaying monsters and demons in Inazuma in ages past!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: And of course, there shall also be the most quintessential elements of love and comedy...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: However, this is just a preliminary thought. I still have much material to gather.
